audit_items.proof_trace: The validation at line 141 checks payload.parent_hash == state.latest_execution_payload_header.block_hash ONLY when IsMergeTransitionComplete returns true. However, during the first block after merge transition, the state has an empty execution header, causing the check at line 134 to skip validation entirely (returns nil at line 135). This means the first post-merge block can have an arbitrary parent_hash that does not chain to any legitimate block, violating the invariant.
audit_items.attack_scenario: During merge transition, attacker proposes the first post-merge block with a malicious parent_hash that does not chain to the previous execution state. Validation is bypassed (line 134-135), allowing the invalid payload to be written to beacon state (ProcessPayload line 222), causing all subsequent blocks to chain from this invalid base and resulting in consensus failure.
